name: ocudu-tools
description: Skills for the OCUDU 5G CU/DU project

plugins.name: ci-triage
plugins.description: Triage failed jobs in a GitLab CI pipeline — match each failing test to one issue in the ocudu group, or flag it as new.

plugins.name: analyze-ran-log
plugins.description: Analyze, summarize, query, or root-cause RAN test artifacts — OCUDU gnb/du/cu logs and configs, Amarisoft UE logs, VIAVI RU-simulator logs, NGAP/F1AP/E1AP/MAC/RLC pcaps — and correlate them across a whole run.

plugins.name: ocudu-code-review
plugins.description: Review OCUDU C++ changes — a diff, a branch or a GitLab MR — for correctness and conventions, real-time-path safety, and security.

plugins.name: ocudu-guidelines-review
plugins.description: Review OCUDU code against the OCUDU code guide, so changes follow the project's conventions; writes a report and a patch with the fixes.
